scope: Preserve the explicit source DWG unit declaration through selected AC1018 SAT-v1 solid ASCII/Binary DXF projections and verify it after fresh readback. This closes a unit-metadata transport check for this source profile only; it does not establish source placement semantics or promote support claims.

unitField.headerVariable: INSUNITS (stored under the unprefixed DWG header key)

source.producerProvenance: The public TrattoCAD publisher describes the sample, but does not identify which exact files were saved by its own software; exact producer/toolchain remains unverified.

implementation.change: The locally selected projection now carries the imported source header and asserts the exact integer $INSUNITS value after each fresh DXF readback. The shared test accessor accepts both prefixed DXF and unprefixed DWG header map keys.
implementation.same_test_operation: For every selected handle, ASCII and Binary output still checks exact normalized SAT payload readback, stable nonzero output identity, layer/EED shape, declared-range mutation refusal with destination sentinel preservation, and corrected same-adapter retry.

validation.run: For each handle 0x2a through 0x59, run the physical SAT-v1 projection selector against the hash-bound DWG.
validation.result: 48/48 handles passed; each had successful ASCII and Binary fresh readback with source $INSUNITS=4 and unchanged normalized SAT payload.
validation.fixturePolicy: The DWG remains in /private/tmp; no external drawing fixture was added to Git.

limitations: This is selected-record transport and header preservation, not whole-document output; the full source remains refused at unrelated closure gates.

A valid INSUNITS value does not establish placement, orientation, or geometry interpretation. Source-referenced placement remains open; only the previously reported handle-0x2d dimension comparison has a published geometric reference.
The producer/toolchain for the exact DWG is not authenticated, and this result does not establish broader producer support or native consumer acceptance.
ODA §20.4.41 does not define the SAT body coordinate basis. Source-referenced placement remains unresolved even though the DWG $INSUNITS metadata roundtrips.

specificationBoundary.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.41
specificationBoundary.finding: The documented modeler-version-1 SAT framing specifies bounded encoded character blocks. The listed axis/translation/scale transform fields belong to optional wireframe records, not the extracted SAT body. The section does not define a coordinate basis for SAT body coordinates.
specificationBoundary.effect: The unit header readback does not close source-referenced placement; preserve that gate.
